content.short: WalkersCNFT is an innovative Move-to-Earn GameFi project on Cardano that rewards users for physical activity.
content.description: WalkersCNFT is an innovative GameFi application on the Cardano blockchain that incentivizes a healthy lifestyle through a 'Move-to-Earn' model. By using unique Walker NFTs, participants earn experience points and rewards for their daily physical activity, which can be converted into the native $WLK token or partner rewards. The platform features WalkPass NFTs that grant holders minting priority, staking benefits, and exclusive real-world partnership discounts. By gamifying fitness and leveraging blockchain technology, WalkersCNFT empowers a global community to monetize their personal health.
